name: Ikenai Keiyaku Kekkon ~Kyuukyoku no Sentaku~
original_name: イケない契約結婚～究極の選択～
source:
I’ll pay off your debt. In exchange, you have to marry me.’

You’re fifty million yen in debt, and you have no way to pay it back…but bad luck turns to good when some men show up needing a wife!

A sudden marriage with an idol, a nightclub owner, or even a rich young company president?! Placed between a rock and several celebrity boyfriends…will your fake love that starts from marriage bloom into true love?

The story starts with the contract marriage everyone’s talking about. Be sure to read the fine print!
translation:
“我会替你还清债务。作为交换，你必须嫁给我。”

你欠下了5000万日元的债务，无力偿还…然而，当几位需要妻子的男人出现在面前时，厄运似乎迎来了转机！

突然与偶像、夜店老板，甚至年轻富有的公司总裁结婚？！身陷困境，又面对几位名人男友…从婚姻开始的虚假爱情，能否最终开花，成为真爱？

故事从众人热议的契约婚姻开始。千万别忘了看清合同上的细则！
